presets.label: Preset
presets.empty: No presets yet. You can save the current settings
presets.saveNew: Save current settings as a preset
presets.hint.image: Saves prompts, LoRAs, reference images, model and settings together (not the seed or the count)
presets.hint.video: Saves the prompts, model, size, length and quality settings (not the seed or the source picture)
presets.hint.music: Saves the style tags and the song settings (not the lyrics or the seed)
presets.hint.voice: Saves the language and the voice (speaker and manner, or the voice description), not the text to speak
presets.hint.text: Saves a text style (font, fill, outlines, shadow, spacing) and applies it to the selected text
presets.text.selectLayer: Select a text layer to save or apply a style
presets.hint.logo: Saves the style and shape (not the text in the logo)
